sections.h1Accent: Animated, Design-Led Sites for Startups and Launches

body.text: Framer website development at Teknoppy gives startups, product teams and brands polished, animated websites that launch quickly and stay easy to update. Framer is a visual website builder made for designers, and we use it to turn bold ideas into fast, responsive sites without the limits of standard templates.

paragraphs.text: What is Framer? Framer is a website platform built for designers. Pages are laid out visually, much like in a design tool, and published directly as live, responsive websites with hosting included. It includes a content management system, built-in animations, localization and SEO settings, so many sites need no separate developer tools at all. Framer began as a prototyping tool for product designers, which is why its layout and motion controls feel so natural to design teams.
Framer website development is a strong fit when design quality and speed to launch matter most: startup and product sites, campaign pages, portfolios and company sites that change often.

sections.h2: What Framer Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Framer Website Design
items.html: Framer website design starts with your audience, product and the one action you want visitors to take. We create a clear page structure, a type and colour system, and layouts that work on desktop, tablet and mobile.

items.title: Framer Startup Website
items.text: A Framer startup website suits founders who need a credible site for launch, fundraising or hiring in days or weeks, not months. Sections can be duplicated, reordered and reworded as the product evolves, without waiting for a developer. Investor, careers and product pages can all live on the same site and share one consistent design system.

items.title: Figma to Framer
items.text: If your designs already exist in Figma, our Figma to Framer service turns them into a live, responsive Framer site. We rebuild layouts properly rather than pasting static images, so text stays editable, images stay sharp and pages stay fast.

items.title: Framer Animations and Interactions
items.text: Framer animations and interactions add scroll effects, hover states, page transitions and subtle motion that make a brand feel premium. Our Framer developers keep motion purposeful and light, test it on low-end phones, and reduce it for visitors who prefer less movement.

items.title: Framer CMS Setup
items.text: Framer CMS setup structures blog posts, case studies, team profiles, job openings and changelogs as collections, so every new item uses the right layout automatically. Your team adds new content through simple, clearly labelled forms, and new entries appear on the site as soon as they are published.

items.title: Framer Localization
items.text: Framer localization serves English, Arabic and other languages from one project, with translated pages and URLs. It suits startups and brands selling to India and the Gulf from one site.

sections.intro: As a Framer agency India and GCC clients work with, we cover design, build, launch and ongoing care.

paragraphs.text: Is Framer good for SEO? Yes, when it is set up properly. Framer publishes fast, server-rendered pages and supports custom titles, descriptions, clean URLs, redirects, sitemaps and social sharing images.

Our Framer SEO setup covers metadata for every page, heading structure, image alt text, redirects from any old site, structured data and Google Search Console connection. We also keep animations from hiding text from search engines, which is a common problem on design-heavy sites.

sections.h2: When Framer Is Not the Right Choice

paragraphs.text: Framer is not ideal for every project. Large online stores, sites with hundreds of complex content types, or projects that need deep custom integrations are usually better served by other platforms. During discovery we tell you honestly whether Framer website development fits your plans for the next two to three years, not only for launch day.

sections.h2: Framer vs Webflow and Framer vs WordPress

paragraphs.html: Both are visual website builders with hosting and CMS included. Framer is faster for design-led marketing sites and feels closer to a design tool. Webflow offers more detailed control over structure, CMS logic and ecommerce. For content-heavy or more complex sites, see our Webflow development page.

paragraphs.text: WordPress relies on themes and plugins that need regular updates. Framer includes design, hosting, security and updates in one platform, which suits small teams that want low upkeep. WordPress suits large content libraries and sites that depend on specific plugins.

sections.h2: How Much Does a Framer Website Cost?

paragraphs.text: How much does a Framer website cost? It depends on the number of pages, CMS collections, languages and custom animations. Framer also charges its own monthly or yearly site plan for hosting and features, billed directly by Framer.
Every project is quoted after a short discovery call, and the quote is fixed for the agreed scope. Each quote for Framer website development lists exactly what is included.

items.q: Can my team edit a Framer website?
items.a: Yes. Your team can change text, images and CMS items directly in Framer, and publish with one click. We set up layouts so edits do not break the design, and we train your team at launch.

items.q: How long does a Framer website take?
items.a: A startup or landing-style site usually takes 2 to 3 weeks. A larger CMS or multilingual site takes 4 to 6 weeks. We confirm the timeline in writing after discovery.

items.q: Do I own my Framer website?
items.a: Yes. The project is created in your Framer account or transferred to you at launch, and you control the domain, content and billing.

Yes. Framer manages hosting, security certificates and platform updates, so there are no plugins or servers for you to patch. We add two-step login and give each team member only the access they need.

items.q: What do we receive at handover?
items.a: You receive full access to the Framer project, a short written editing guide, a recorded training session and a list of every integration and setting used. Nothing is held back, so simple changes never depend on us.
